reviewer_note: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the author of the migration; no human review claimed
scope: Branch claude/use-case-records at 8a81eb7 over origin/main 1ebc8b5: batch data/omics/use-case-records-20261009 (26 use_case records, 100 relevance judgement claims, 1 draft summary claim) and presentation.json; deriveUseCaseInputs and judgementPins in shared/omics/use-cases.ts; migrate-use-cases.ts; repin-use-cases.ts; docs/use-cases.md; rb.ttl, mapping.json, relevance.ttl, context.ttl, sepio-subset.nt and its sources.json entry, scripts/kg/build.py PROTECTED and scripts/kg/export.ts. Baseline: origin/main data/omics/use-cases/inputs.json and sources.json.

results.round_trip: 26 of 26 use cases and 100 of 100 mappings identical to origin/main inputs.json, ignoring presentation (9 mappings), summary (1 use case) and evaluation_ids order (37 mappings)
results.fidelity: All use-case and mapping fields present and equal; reviewer_note verbatim in 126 records; excluded_evaluations exact for all 100 judgements
results.lifecycle: 97 active to source_checked, 3 drafts to needs_review; derived output 97 active, 3 draft
results.presentation: Values match presentation.json; Behera bins match Table S4 rows 6-10 in order; every headline metric exists among its protocol's results
results.sepio: sepio.owl 2023-06-13 re-downloaded, sha256 matches source_sha256; extract_terms.py reproduces sepio-subset.nt byte for byte

limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review.
Source documents were not re-read; summary numbers were checked against stored result records, which an earlier review checked against the sources.
Gate probes edited an in-memory store; no release was built from this branch during the review.
Whether the website shows draft summaries was not checked (rewire-database is out of scope).

errors.message: Evaluation set is live: a disputed evaluation or configuration is dropped and the judgement stays active (probe: use-case-map-gears-norman-table6-mse, 4 to 3 evaluations). Old evidence_sha256 withheld it. shared/omics/use-cases.ts deriveUseCaseInputs.

Pin set misses meaning-bearing fields: protocol name, description, metric, metric_direction, dataset, task, facets; use case name, description, setting, clinical_scope, intended_users, contexts; relation names; 12 judgements cite unpinned sources. 23 of 98 mapped protocols have neither attributes.protocol nor attributes.version. shared/omics/use-cases.ts judgementPinFields.

Draft summary: 'missed half or more of the deletions under 10 kb' is false for 5-10 kb (CNVnator recall 0.505); 'depth-only callers 11 to 43%' omits CLC (0.012) and no record classifies callers by signal; omits the truth-set bias in favour of Manta and CNVnator; the duplication statement needs checking.
The needs_review summary is emitted into use-cases.json as status draft, and a reviewed summary has no pins or source gate.
Task becoming inactive, or a use-case citation gaining an evidence concern, now makes buildUseCaseArtifact throw instead of withholding.
scripts/omics/repin-use-cases.ts re-pins every mismatched source_checked judgement, so using it for a new judgement (docs/use-cases.md step 3) would re-activate withheld judgements without review.
Withdrawn, superseded or disputed judgements vanish from the artifact without a tombstone; next.mjs withheld does not detect a removed mapping; derive throws while the assessed_by link remains.
evaluation_ids silently truncated at 100; this mapping has 97.

Ontology wording: rb:assessedBy says reviewed-only but 3 draft links are asserted; RelevanceJudgement comment does not fit outside_scope; 'other claims are study findings' is inaccurate; SEPIO has_evidence domain is proposition or assertion.
not_assessed allowed by mappingSchema but absent from data/vocab/relevance.ttl.
reviewer keys include workers as well as reviewers in 29 records; reviewer_note keeps the full text.
README says mappings are identical in every field; they now also carry presentation and one use case a summary.
